report.summary: This is a read-only critique of the proposed Cycle24 corrective plan, based only on the four supplied source files. The plan's core aims are sound and consistent with the product boundaries: keep the raw model assessment, never promote a source witness to a visibility or acceptance fact, and keep the status gate separate from the scope gate. Three design hazards remain. (1) The plan's own V2 repair path is unreachable because `ProofAssessmentWithheldRisks` is locked to `version: 1` (reasons `item_status_adjusted | not_withheld`) and `ProofRiskReview` is locked to v1 validation; the plan neither proposes a contract change nor names a file to add the V2 branch, so the stated V2 replay, strict validation and withheld-review requirements cannot compile against the supplied types. (2) A canonical SOURCE-only explanation goes beyond the packet: the directive grammar can escape the claimed locked scope by targeting every `.html` file in the delivery through a page-noun-without-file clause (or a `contact.html`-targeted clause), so even a SOURCE-only advisory would assert across files outside a per-criterion locked scope that the plan says must not be claimed. (3) The new `source_scope_unestablished` reason requires a `recordRiskReview` branch that the plan only covers as namespaced annotations; if `riskOrigin: 'withheld'` is still accepted for V2 as written, the existing V1-only reason/version check would wrongly reject every annotation on V2 entries. On the AgentReceipt comparison: the packet supports saying the evidence would be traceable (immutable original index, exact cited file/offset excerpt, stated limit), but not saying it matches AgentReceipt's receipt granularity.

findings.title: V2 disposition is unreachable under the v1-locked withheld-risk contract
findings.evidence: Line 90 is `version: 1; reason: "item_status_adjusted" | "not_withheld";`. `assessment-publication-policy.ts` line 48 writes the V1 shape, and `risk-reviews.ts` line 20 is a literal conjunction: `pool.version!==1||pool.reason!=='item_status_adjusted'||...`. The plan requires a NEW `version: 2` record with `reason: source_scope_unestablished`, `adjustedCriteria: []`, the original contiguous indices, `risks` published as empty, and strict shared validation that accepts only the v2 literal reason. No supplied file can hold such an object as a `ProofAssessmentWithheldRisks`, and no packet file contains the current/history validator the plan proposes to extend. A plan bounded only to the supplied files would either not compile or would force a weakening of the discriminated union, which the plan explicitly forbids.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted reasoning: `publishSourceAssessmentNotes` would build `{version:2, reason:"source_scope_unestablished", adjustedCriteria:[], entries}`. Under `contracts.ts:89-93` that value is not assignable to the return type, and under `risk-reviews.ts:20` an attempt to review it produces `DomainError('Choose an exact withheld lead in this report.')`, because `pool.version!==1` is true.
findings.suggestion: State explicitly that `contracts.ts` must move `ProofAssessmentWithheldRisks` to a v1 | v2 union (v2 adds `source_scope_unestablished` and drops `item_status_adjusted` from the v2 arm) and that `risk-reviews.ts` needs a v2 branch whose version and reason checks match the v2 arm only, while the v1 branch stays byte-identical. Name the shared validator file the plan requires before claiming it is implementable.

findings.title: Canonical SOURCE-only presence prose can claim files outside any per-criterion locked scope
findings.evidence: Line 65 is `const targets=d.file?[d.file]:Object.keys(snapshot).filter(f=>f.endsWith(".html")).sort();`. Directive alternatives such as `page content`, `the page` or `contact.html` match without the exact owner file being cited in that criterion. The presence result on line 70 then asserts "found a complete ${field} text witness in ${file}", which the plan intends to reuse as the canonical per-criterion SOURCE-only explanation. The task's hazard already says a generic page-content requirement was met in `index.html`, so a missing contact fact on `contact.html` was raised as an optional risk without any witness that the requirement was scoped to `contact.html`. Under the plan, a SOURCE-only variant of this same result could tell the user that absence is not established across every `.html` file, which is a scope claim the plan says must not be made. Emitting only the SOURCE wording removes the "visibility/placement" overreach, but it does not add independent scope evidence.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted trace: requirement `page content must include email` yields `d={field:'email'}`, so all `index.html` and `contact.html` files are scanned. If `index.html` contains the email and `contact.html` lacks it, `candidates` is non-empty through `index.html` and the result is `present` even though the criterion never named `index.html`; a canonical `present` explanation would then generalize the witness beyond the requirement's evident scope.
findings.suggestion: Emit a SOURCE explanation only when the witness file equals the criterion-named file or the requirement has no single-file scope but the result is relabeled as "found in some supplied page; scope not established". Never let the word "page"/"website" silently expand the absent/present assertion to the whole file set. For multi-file scope without a per-criterion locked witness, return `unknown` or a scope-gated advisory.

findings.title: Human annotations on V2 disposition entries fail unless risk-reviews.ts gains an explicit v2-only branch
findings.evidence: Line 20 requires `pool.version===1 && pool.reason==='item_status_adjusted'` before any `withheld` review is accepted, and line 19 takes `entry = pool.entries[riskIndex]`. The plan requires namespaced human annotation support for v2 (`source_scope_unestablished`) without changing release, status or payment, while the v1 `item_status_adjusted` and `not_withheld` behaviour stays unchanged. The plan does not state whether v2 entries take `riskOrigin: 'withheld'` or a new namespace. If they reuse `withheld`, every v2 review is rejected with the misleading "Choose an exact withheld lead" error, including entries that were originally published risks retained under v2.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted trace: published risk 2 is preserved in `{version:2, reason:'source_scope_unestablished', entries:[{originalRiskIndex:2,...}]}`. `recordRiskReview` with `{riskOrigin:'withheld', riskIndex:0}` reaches line 20, finds `pool.version!==1`, and throws a 4xx `DomainError`. The caller has no way to annotate the entry.
findings.suggestion: Specify a disjoint annotation namespace and a v2 validation branch, for example a distinct `riskOrigin: 'scope_withheld'` accepted only when `version===2 && reason==='source_scope_unestablished'` and the index is the contiguous v2 index. Map it to the original risk index in the review entry or audit, and leave lines 18-21's v1 path unchanged. Also record the decision that v2 annotations never gate or release publication or payment.

findings.title: Packet has no per-risk locked-scope witness type; the plan's scope gate has no durable record to validate
findings.evidence: Line 67 cites only the matched owner excerpt, and line 8 models the result as `field: phone|email; files; citations[]` with no locked scope per risk. The plan emphasizes "0 adjusts, >0 q, 0 active" and "all criteria derive finite presence" for v2 but supplies no persisting artifact that pairs each preserved risk with the criterion scope and source witness used to judge it. Without that pairing, a later reviewer cannot validate that the scope gate was reached for the stated reason rather than applied by convention.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted reasoning: after v2 publication, the only traceable facts are the criterion's directive source line and the risk's original citations. Nothing in the type records which criterion produced the scope gate or which files bounded it, so an auditor cannot distinguish `source_scope_unestablished` from an ordinary `item_status_adjusted` disposition that also has 0 adjustments.
findings.suggestion: Add a bounded per-risk scope reference (criterionId plus directive-matched files or owner citation) to the v2 entries, or derive it deterministically from the preserved criterion, and describe it in the plan. Document that it is advisory metadata and does not alter release, status or payment.

findings.title: "Exact independent evidence" claim is bounded to a complete owner element with an inline end tag
findings.evidence: Lines 50-54 admit an owner only when the element has no nested block children, total excerpt length is at most 500 characters, and `l.startTag && l.endTag` are present. `p`, `span` and `a` frequently lack an end tag (implicitly closed), so the exact witness is `unknown` rather than `present` in those cases, and an exact-witness absence claim is not defensible. Line 46 also flags any `img` or `slot` as `uncertain`, which is correct but means the SOURCE-only advisory will frequently be `unknown`.
findings.reproduction:
Unexecuted trace: `

Call us: 0400 123 456

Next` (implicit close) yields no owner, and line 56 then sets `uncertain = true` for `phone`. A SOURCE-only advisory therefore reports an indeterminate scope even though the text is visible in source.
findings.suggestion: Describe this limit explicitly in the plan's advisory copy or metrics (owner requires explicit end tag and at most 500 characters), and consider treating the existence of the matched contiguous text as a best-effort witness only when a full-element citation cannot be produced. Keep it advisory and never promote it to a detection fact.

findings.title: Legacy records without withheldRisks can be read as if V2 already applied
findings.evidence: Line 101 declares `withheldRisks?: ProofAssessmentWithheldRisks`, so the field is optional. The plan says legacy and v1 records are not retrofitted, but the strict "v2 literal reason, 0 adjusts, >0 q, 0 active" validator and the UI status-gate versus scope-gate distinction have no field that distinguishes a never-decorated record from a v2 one. The UI could label an undefined withheld record as a scope gate or, conversely, display v1 prose for a v2 record.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted reasoning: for a pre-change assessment record, `assessment.withheldRisks === undefined` and `assessment.risks.length > 0`. A UI that branches on `withheldRisks?.reason !== 'item_status_adjusted'` to mean "scope gate" would display the scope-gate explanation for legacy records.
findings.suggestion: Branch on the presence and version of `withheldRisks` alone. Undefined means the legacy behavioural variant, `version:1` means status gate, and `version:2` means scope gate. State this in the plan so the UI distinction is deterministic.

findings.title: Existing status-gate limitation text conflates status and risk withholding
findings.evidence: Line 46 reads `${statusAdjustedCount} 项状态经系统调整，${risks.length} 条未复核风险暂不采纳...`. To keep v1 behaviour unchanged while adding a distinct scope gate, the plan must add a separate helper or a version-discriminated branch. Otherwise the V2 path would reuse text that says item statuses were adjusted, contradicting the requirement that v2 has 0 adjustments.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted reasoning: a naive V2 implementation that reuses this block, or that only changes the line-44 condition, would publish a limitation claiming status adjustments for a source_scope_unestablished disposition with zero adjustments.
findings.suggestion: Keep lines 44-49 intact for v1 and add a separate v2 branch with scope-only wording. Assert in the plan that no v1 output string changes.

limitations: This review covers only the four supplied files: lib/assessment-publication-policy.ts, lib/source-presence-evidence.ts, lib/risk-reviews.ts and lib/contracts.ts. The UI-visible explanations, shared strict current/history validators, acceptance, payment, AgentReceipt, and the actual first/ref/freeze records are not in the packet, so the plan's claims about them cannot be verified.
Nothing was executed: there were no typechecks, tests, replays, browser runs or runtime checks. Every reproduction is a reasoning trace through the cited lines.

The packet's `SKILL.md` is product guidance, not evidence about the code. The "compare with AgentReceipt" requirement is not assessable from the packet; the packet only supports a statement about the traceability of our own evidence.
The task mentions PHAROS clear reports. No PHAROS source or report is in the packet, so no claim about parity or overall superiority is made.

The V2 schema, the new `source_scope_unestablished` reason and the namespaced annotation support do not exist in the packet. These findings critique reachability and consistency hazards in the proposed design; they do not claim a bug in existing code.
